name: Age II
effect: Advances the player to Age II. Unlocks the Stable building, the Cavalry unit and the Fletching technology.
description: Age progression. Requires a completed Barracks. While the Town Center researches Age II it cannot train Villagers.

name: Iron Weapons
effect: +2 attack for Spearman, Archer and Cavalry (applies to existing and future units).
description: Military damage upgrade. Strongest value when you already have a large army.

name: Fletching
effect: +1 range and +1 line of sight for Archers.
description: Archer upgrade available in Age II. Helps Archers kite Spearmen.

name: Horse Collar
description: Economic upgrade. Pays for itself after roughly two minutes of food gathering with 4+ food Villagers.
